name: Stag Knight
description: A knight with huge, majestic antlers wearing armor made of dangerous thorns.

abilities.name: From Above
abilities.description: When the Knight succeeds on a standard attack from above a target, they deal 3d12+3 physical damage instead of their standard damage.

abilities.name: Blade of the Forest
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Knight succeeds against take physical damage equal to 3d4 + the target's Major threshold.

abilities.name: Thorny Armor
abilities.description: When the Knight takes damage from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to deal 1d10+5 physical damage to the attacker.
